content.text:
I fixed the About page on phones. The cause was a leftover `.story { grid-template-columns: 1fr 480px; }` rule at the very end of `site/css/pages.css`. It sat after the phone media query, so it overrode the single-column layout. The 480px image column then forced the page wider than a phone screen (620px wide against 390px). I deleted that rule. The desktop layout already had the same setting earlier in the file, so it doesn't change.

All 28 tests pass, including the About phone screenshot comparison that was failing before.

STATUS: DONE
